THAT IS A STATEMENT ABOUT OUR ACCESS, NOT ABOUT NEW HAMPSHIRE (§0.4).

3 rows (3 at $1) whose 'awardee' is not an organisation that received money: 'GO-NORTH Endowment Population Health', 'GO-NORTH Planning Grant Agreement', 'Governor's Office of New Opportunities & Rural Transformational Health (GO-NORTH)'. An agreement and an endowment line are §6.1's PROGRAM_NAME_AS_AWARDEE; GO-NORTH itself is the State's own administering office, i.e. the grantor filed as its own recipient. The $1 is Missouri's placeholder mechanism again, and it runs through this whole candidate set: FHC, CDFA and the administrators carry $1 rows too. RCJ publishes a PLACEHOLDER rather than a wrong figure, which is the one defect no amount check can see.
